title: The Locust Plague and the Cry to the Lord
description: A mighty army of locusts ravages the land, destroying crops, vineyards, and livestock. The prophet Joel calls the people, especially the elders and priests, to put on sackcloth, mourn, and hold a holy fast while crying out to the Lord for help in light of the coming Day of the Lord. [ref:Joel 1:1-20|Joel 1:1-20]
